Form controls

Formato 0000/AAAA.
Informe um valor maior que zero.

Form labels are .ui-field__label — 14px, weight 500, sentence case, ink. Dense app forms want .ui-form--compact for a 36–40px control height. The 11px uppercase style belongs to .filter-field__label, table headers, and .ui-dl dt — not to form fields.
